items.definition:
Of poor quality; dirty or unpleasant.
The hotel room was really crummy and needed a renovation.

further down the playing field
The quarterback threw a long pass downfield.

strange or eccentric
Her kooky sense of humor always makes everyone laugh.

cautious or wary due to suspicion
She was leery of trusting him after he had lied before.

pleasant-sounding; tuneful
The bird's song was melodious and calming.

former; previous
He was a onetime champion in the boxing world.

able to be solved or explained
The puzzle seemed difficult, but it was ultimately solvable.

smaller than or occurring within an atom
Scientists study subatomic particles.

not valued or recognized
His efforts often went unappreciated.

impossible or too difficult to play
The tennis court was unplayable due to the rain.

worth watching; entertaining
Despite the low budget, the movie was surprisingly watchable.

resembling ashes in color or texture
His skin looked ashy after being out in the cold.

Fond of reading and studying; scholarly.
She had a quiet, bookish nature and preferred libraries to parties.

Resembling a brute; savage, cruel, or uncivilized.
His brutish behavior made everyone uncomfortable.

Constant and unending.
The ceaseless rain made the river overflow its banks.

recklessly bold or rash
It was a foolhardy decision to climb the mountain without proper gear.

lacking courage or determination
He was criticized for his gutless response to the challenge.

out of control; crazy
The computer went haywire after the power surge.

able to be seen or noticed
There was a perceptible change in her mood.

relating to or characteristic of poetry
His writing style was very poetical and evocative.

containing starch; stiff or formal in manner
Potatoes are a starchy vegetable.

designed for or frequented by tourists
We avoided the main square because it was too touristy.

nervous or jumpy
He became very twitchy whenever he heard a loud noise.

without help
She managed to climb the wall unassisted.

not having a rank or official position
The new player was unranked in the tournament.

not giving satisfaction
The ending of the movie was very unsatisfying.

not damaged or corrupted
The remote island remains largely unspoiled by tourism.

saturated with water
After the heavy rain, the garden was completely waterlogged.

Spiteful or malicious, often in a sly or indirect way.
Her catty remarks made everyone uncomfortable.

Capable of making mistakes or being wrong
Even experts are fallible.

sounding rough and deep; full of gravel
He spoke in a gravelly voice after shouting all night.

not objectionable or harmful
He made an inoffensive remark that no one could possibly take issue with.

possessing or exhibiting knowledge, intelligence, or perception
She is very knowledgable about ancient history.

relating to the position or alignment of the body
Good postural alignment is important for preventing back pain.

having a pleasing shape
She admired the shapely curves of the vase.

not new or interesting; derivative
His ideas for the project were rather unoriginal.

using too many words
His explanation was too wordy and confusing.

easily bent; flexible
The bendy straw made it easier to drink.

relating to the distribution of something; (grammar) referring to each individual of a group
The distributive property is fundamental in algebra.

very unusual or strange
The weather took a freakish turn, with snow in July.

impossible to read
The old manuscript was almost illegible due to fading ink.
